brand_rules.core_visual_language: 冷暖對比：城市=冷色（壓力），紫微堂=暖光（理解），命盤空間=黑底金色
brand_rules.tone: 寫實為底、神秘但不玄幻、電影感

assets.placement: 第一節「一座城市，兩種光」之前，作為文章開場圖
assets.purpose: 建立城市＝冷色壓力的世界觀第一印象
assets.scene_zh: 2026 年台北雨夜，捷運站出口的傘海人潮，霓虹燈光反射在濕漉漉的柏油路面，冷藍與青綠色調，遠景帶 101 剪影
assets.prompt_en: Rainy night in Taipei 2026, crowd with umbrellas at MRT station exit, neon reflections on wet asphalt, cold blue and teal color palette, cinematic wide shot, realistic, moody

assets.placement: 第二節「山腰上的紫微堂」段末
assets.purpose: 呈現紫微堂＝暖光避風港
assets.scene_zh: 山腰樹林間的木造老屋「紫微堂」，黃昏，門口燈籠亮著暖光，窗內透出油燈光，剛下過雨的濕潤感，樹葉滴水
assets.prompt_en: A wooden traditional house on a forested hillside at dusk, warm lantern glowing at the entrance, warm light through windows, wet leaves after rain, warm orange and wood tones, cinematic, cozy and serene

assets.placement: 第三節「堂主潔米爸」段末
assets.purpose: 潔米爸定裝形象照（部落格用主視覺）
assets.scene_zh: 潔米爸在紫微堂內倒茶，暖油燈光，木質空間，神情溫和沉穩
assets.prompt_en: A calm, warm 45-year-old Taiwanese man, 185cm, salt-and-pepper short hair, thin-rimmed glasses, wearing a deep navy mandarin-collar shirt, gentle tired eyes, pouring tea at a low wooden table, warm oil-lamp lighting, cinematic warm tones
